value.rationale: This canonical four-regular, triangle-free, four-chromatic graph has exactly one minimal induced octahedral torsion carrier among 423 shortest possible spheres, yet all 423 together generate full integral third homology. The sharp carrier order dichotomy gives a meaningful local-to-global explanation beyond Betti numbers, and contrasts structurally with known Grötzsch and icosahedral matching complexes.
